notes: NSW Planning Portal project SSD-69223466 shows Project Pluto Data Centre in Cumberland, decision approved, determination date 23/07/2026, and describes construction and operation of a 126MW-load data centre at 132 McCredie Road, Guildford West with two three-storey buildings, substations, ancillary office space, parking, landscaping, and demolition works.
